title: A full gate's temp guard failed on a stray __PSScriptPolicyTest_*.ps1 left in the test run root, suspect a test that terminates a real PowerShell child during startup
outcome: A full gate's temp guard failed on a stray __PSScriptPolicyTest_*.ps1 left in the test run root, suspect a test that terminates a real PowerShell child during startup
acceptance: A deterministic witness first fails on the unmodified code: a test launches the control fixture through a production Engram launch path in a mode that prints the child's TEMP, and the child's TEMP is the test process's TEMP (the run root), not a directory inside its Engram home.

Under test, every Engram fixture launch path (diagnostic, authority revoke, control process, CLI command, context nudge, bounded read) gives its child TEMP and TMP inside its Engram home, so a PowerShell child terminated during startup leaves its __PSScriptPolicyTest_* files there, where the test's temp root removes them, and not in the run root; tests show the placement through the diagnostic launch path and through apply_engram_connection_environment, and show that nothing is created or redirected for a home outside the test temp root. Production launches are unchanged, and the temp guard is not widened.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

completion.summary: Under test, every Engram fixture launch path gives its child TEMP, TMP and TMPDIR in <home>/child-temp, plus TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP. A PowerShell child killed during startup now leaves its __PSScriptPolicyTest_* probe in the home, removed with the test's root, instead of in the shared run root. Nothing is created or redirected for a home outside the test temp root or for a child-temp linked out of its home. Production and the temp guard are unchanged. Fail-first verified (49c0e7ff); round-3 gate test-3eeae695 passed (fingerprint cfadac69…02ac); three review rounds, all Mediums fixed; evaluation passed 3/3. Landed 646d250, installed b7388781.
